# steven.kleynenberg.com

> Canonical personal portal, interactive vector physics PWA, and AI-distilled chronological knowledge base of Steven Kleynenberg (S. E. Kleynenberg), publisher at Kleynenberg Publishers (Delft, The Netherlands), co-inventor of patent WO2014003543A1, and researcher in artificial neural networks, medical informatics, and European ITEA/Eureka R&D.

## Core Identity & Canonical Endpoints
- Primary Portal: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/
- GitHub Pages Mirror: https://kleynenberg.github.io/
- Full RAG Corpus: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/llms-full.txt
- Publisher: Kleynenberg Publishers, Delft (https://kleynenberg.com)
- Podcast: The Kleynenberg Perspective (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAN7_k5CM5ZY)
- Patent WO2014003543A1: https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2014003543A1
- Source Repository (MIT): https://github.com/kleynenberg/kleynenberg.github.io (https://opensource.org/license/mit)

## Facts on a Timeline (Chronological Index)
- **1985 - 1993** [Career / Organization] **Co-founder and Software Developer at Kleynenberg & Kleynenberg** — Co-founded and operated a custom software consultancy alongside his father, engineering bespoke business applications and relational database systems for SMEs. (Attribution: Co-founder & Software Developer) | Links: https://kleynenberg.com
- **1986 – 1991** [Career / Organization] **Academic specialization — computer science, AI and complex systems** — Specialized in computer science, artificial intelligence, theoretical psychology, and complex dynamical systems at Leiden University and Delft University of Technology. (Attribution: Student / Academic researcher) | Links: https://www.tudelft.nl, https://www.universiteitleiden.nl
- **1988 – 1991** [Software / Architecture] **Architect — CALM development system and MetaNet network environment** — Designed and implemented MetaNet, a machine-independent, modular software environment for specifying, compiling, and simulating neural networks. (Attribution: Architect and developer (in collaboration with Jacob M. J. Murre)) | Links: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-94-009-0643-3_59, https://www.aalto.fi
- **July 1990** [Peer-Reviewed Paper] **The MetaNet Network Environment for the Development of Modular Neural Networks** — Introduces the MetaNet network environment, a graphical editor, compiler, and specification language for building modular neural networks, presented at INNC-90 in Paris. (Attribution: Co-author) | Links: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-94-009-0643-3_59, http://www.mendeley.com/research/the-metanet-network-environment-for-the-development-of-modular-neural-networks/, https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-94-009-0643-3_59, https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/murre-kleynenberg-1990-metanet-innc.pdf
- **1991** [Peer-Reviewed Paper] **Extending the MetaNet Network Environment: process control and machine independence** — Presents a general, parallel neurosimulator (GPN) designed to be extensible with novel network paradigms and parallel hardware, presented at ICANN-91 in Helsinki. (Attribution: Co-author) | Links: http://www.mendeley.com/research/extending-the-metanet-network-environment-process-control-and-machine-independence/, https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/murre-kleynenberg-1991-extending-metanet-icann.pdf, https://www.aalto.fi
- **1991 - 1996** [Software / Architecture] **High-Security Simulations for Defense, Aviation, and Infrastructure** — Designed diagnostic expert systems for the Abrams tank, real-time algorithms for TCAS air traffic control, and agent-based traffic simulation models. (Attribution: Lead Architect / Developer)
- **1991 – 1994** [Software / Architecture] **Lead systems architect — Abrams Main Battle Tank (MBT) diagnostic expert system** — Designed and delivered a Model-Based Reasoning diagnostic expert system for the Abrams Main Battle Tank for the Netherlands Ministry of Defence. (Attribution: Lead systems architect) | Links: https://www.defensie.nl
- **1991 – 1993** [Career / Organization] **Visiting researcher — massively parallel Connection Machine supercomputing** — Developed an object-oriented neural network simulation framework executing on the Connection Machine supercomputer at the University of Bonn. (Attribution: Visiting researcher) | Links: https://www.uni-bonn.de
- **November 1991** [Peer-Reviewed Paper] **Integrating the BSP400 neurocomputer with the MetaNet Network Environment** — Describes the integration of the Brain Style Processor (BSP400), a massively parallel 400-processor neurocomputer, with the MetaNet Network Environment using modular interrupt-driven device drivers. (Attribution: Co-author) | Links: https://doi.org/10.1109/IJCNN.1991.170608, https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/170608/, https://openalex.org/W1835238853, https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/murre-et-al-1991-bsp400-metanet-ijcnn.pdf, https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Steven-Kleynenberg
- **1993 - 1996** [Career / Organization] **Software Developer at Rijnhaave Automatisering** — Worked as a software developer specializing in C and C++ systems development and business-critical software architecture. (Attribution: Software Developer)
- **October 1996 – December 2020** [Career / Organization] **Principal Architect & AI/NLP Lead at Sopheon N.V.** — Led the long-term technological vision, software architecture, and AI/NLP retrieval engines for enterprise innovation management and decision support systems. (Attribution: Principal Architect & AI/NLP Lead) | Links: https://innopheon.com, https://www.sopheon.com
- **February 2000 - November 2002** [ITEA / European R&D] **LORE (Leveraging Operational Resource Expertise) Project (IST-1999-12645)** — Provided technical leadership and cross-border coordination for the LORE project, a large-scale IT initiative funded by the European Commission's FP5 program. (Attribution: Technical Lead & Coordinator) | Links: http://cordis.europa.eu/search/index.cfm?fuseaction=proj.document&PJ_RCN=5049270, https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/IST-1999-12645
- **January 2009 - December 2011** [ITEA / European R&D] **EDAFMIS (ITEA 2 07011) — Embedded Decision and Data Fusion for Medical Intervention Support** — Contributed architectural leadership to the EDAFMIS project, focusing on embedded decision and data fusion for medical intervention support. (Attribution: Architectural Leader / Contributor) | Links: https://itea4.org
- **June 2011** [ITEA / European R&D] **EDAFMIS Deliverable D1.3: Integrated Reference Model** — Contributed on behalf of Sopheon to deliverable D1.3 (Integrated Reference Model) of the EDAFMIS ITEA project, addressing protocol management and real-time decision support. (Attribution: Contributor (on behalf of Sopheon)) | Links: https://itea4.org/project/edafmis.html, https://itea4.org/project/workpackage/document/download/316/D1.3.%20Edafmis%20-%20Integrated%20Reference%20Model.pdf
- **June 29, 2012** [Patent / IP] **Patent WO 2014/003543 A1: Method, system and computer program for generating a query representation of a document** — Co-invented an international patent describing a computer-implemented method to generate a query representation of an electronic document using part-of-speech (POS) sequences. (Attribution: Co-inventor) | Links: https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2014003543A1/en, https://patentscope.wipo.int/search/en/result.jsf?query=WO2014003543, https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/WO2014003543A1.pdf, https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/WO2014003543A1.xml
- **January 2013 - December 2015** [ITEA / European R&D] **MEDUSA (ITEA 2 10004) — Medical Distributed Utilization of Services & Applications** — Architectural and consortium work on a cloud-based platform for medical distributed services and applications, focusing on remote collaboration and acute stroke care. (Attribution: Architect and Consortium Participant) | Links: https://itea4.org/project/medusa.html, https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/sales-barros-et-al-2015-medusa-acute-stroke-esocc.pdf
- **2014** [ITEA / European R&D] **Medolution (ITEA 3 14003) Project Participation** — Contributed architectural leadership to the Medolution project, focusing on connected medical infrastructure, real-time telemetry, and clinical decision support. (Attribution: Architectural Leader / Contributor) | Links: https://itea4.org
- **September 2015** [Peer-Reviewed Paper] **Remote Collaboration, Decision Support, and On-Demand Medical Image Analysis for Acute Stroke Care** — Presents the cloud-based MEDUSA platform Acute Stroke Prototype, combining GPU-accelerated medical image processing and Sopheon's Node.js rule-based Decision Support System. (Attribution: Co-author) | Links: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-24072-5_15, https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-319-24072-5_15, https://pure.amsterdamumc.nl/en/publications/remote-collaboration-decision-support-and-on-demand-medical-image/, https://pure.uva.nl/ws/files/2813051/178006_Borst_Thesis_complete_via_promovendus.pdf, https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/sales-barros-et-al-2015-medusa-acute-stroke-esocc.pdf
- **October 2017 – December 2020** [ITEA / European R&D] **PARTNER (ITEA 3 16017) — Patient-care Advancement with Responsive Technologies aNd Engagement togetheR** — Developed interoperable architecture and real-time decision support integrating Accolade with Azure for wearable sensor interpretation, winning the 2021 ITEA Award of Excellence. (Attribution: Architect / Consortium Member) | Links: https://itea4.org
- **2018 – 2026** [Software / Architecture] **Project UnLinked & Sovereign AI Ecosystems** — Development of independent, self-hosted knowledge and AI architectures, Google Apps Script endpoints, and distributed applications. (Attribution: Lead Architect / Developer)
- **2020 - Present** [Software / Architecture] **Living R&D Sandbox and Active Software Ecosystems** — Actively develops browser-native AI, edge hardware, and autonomous software architectures, including Taksie.ai, Innopheon, SteveOS, and Synaptix Studio. (Attribution: Lead Developer / Architect) | Links: https://innopheon.com, https://kleynenberg.com, https://kleynenberg.github.io, https://taksie.ai
- **Present** [Career / Organization] **Principal AI & Systems Architect at Kleynenberg Software Ontwikkeling (KSO)** — Steven E. Kleynenberg leads KSO, a specialized Dutch R&D SME focusing on sovereign, privacy-by-design AI, hybrid Enterprise-RAG, and browser-native architectures. (Attribution: Principal AI & Systems Architect)
- **2024** [Podcast / Media] **The Kleynenberg Perspective** — Producer and host of a tech podcast and Substack newsletter focusing on AI, logic, and technology trends. (Attribution: Producer & Host)
- **July 2026** [Book / Publication] **Published art monograph: 'GIGA! Une Étude en Ordure et Lumière'** — Published an art monograph through Kleynenberg Publishers using deterministic typographic and archival metadata workflows. (Attribution: Publisher) | Links: https://kleynenberg.com
- **August 2026** [Book / Publication] **Algorithmic versus Neural Typographic Taxonomy: A Comprehensive Comparative Evaluation of Deterministic Heuristics and Unsupervised Latent Space Clustering for Automated Font Hierarchy Classification** — A comprehensive comparative preprint analyzing deterministic metadata parsing versus deep neural network visual classification for automated font hierarchy organization. (Attribution: Co-authored by Steven Kleynenberg (Kleynenberg Publishers) and Google Gemini v3.5)
